title: Adjunction Unit Transport
statement:

def unitComponent {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D]
    (F : C ⥤ D) (G : D ⥤ C) (η : 𝟭 C ⟶ F ⋙ G) (M : C) :
    M ⟶ G.obj (F.obj M)

theorem unitComponent_eq {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D]
    (F : C ⥤ D) (G : D ⥤ C) (η : 𝟭 C ⟶ F ⋙ G) (M : C) :
    unitComponent F G η M = η.app M

theorem transport_unit_triangles
    {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D]
    (F : C ⥤ D) (G H : D ⥤ C) (e : G ≅ H)
    (η : 𝟭 C ⟶ F ⋙ G) (ε : G ⋙ F ⟶ 𝟭 D) (ε' : H ⋙ F ⟶ 𝟭 D)
    (hε : Functor.whiskerRight e.hom F ≫ ε' = ε)
    (h₁ : ∀ X, F.map (unitComponent F G η X) ≫ ε.app (F.obj X) = 𝟙 _)
    (h₂ : ∀ Y, unitComponent F G η (G.obj Y) ≫ G.map (ε.app Y) = 𝟙 _) :
    ∃ η' : 𝟭 C ⟶ F ⋙ H,
      (∀ X, F.map (η'.app X) ≫ ε'.app (F.obj X) = 𝟙 _) ∧
      (∀ Y, η'.app (H.obj Y) ≫ H.map (ε'.app Y) = 𝟙 _)

theorem first_triangle_of_evaluation_eq
    {C D : Type*} [Category C] [Category D]
    (F : C ⥤ D) (G : D ⥤ C) (η : 𝟭 C ⟶ F ⋙ G) (ε : G ⋙ F ⟶ 𝟭 D)
    (e : ∀ K : D, F.obj (G.obj K) ⟶ K)
    (he : ∀ K, ε.app K = e K)
    (h : ∀ M, F.map (unitComponent F G η M) ≫ e (F.obj M) = 𝟙 _) :
    ∀ M, F.map (unitComponent F G η M) ≫ ε.app (F.obj M) = 𝟙 _

proof.text: Normalize the source and target of a unit component before applying concrete functors. Its component equation is definitional. Construct the adjunction from the two supplied triangles, transport its right adjoint along the given natural isomorphism, and use the prescribed counit equation and inverse cancellation to identify the transported counit. Its two triangles give the claimed unit.

For a componentwise equation between a counit and an evaluation family, substitute that equation in the first triangle and apply the assumed evaluation triangle. Form this congruence before specializing the category and functors.
